persona.reply: You over-explain. Answer what it asks from your knowledge bank, then add one or two sentences it did not ask for: a fact from the bank it has not asked about yet, or harmless backstory (who it is for, why, a worry). Never add a new requirement that is not in the bank. If it asks whether to proceed, say yes and add one more remark. Two to four sentences.
persona.giveUp: ok ok, just do whatever you think is best, honestly i trust you
persona.nudge: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

bank.The request in full, as you would have w: Turn just the black bottle forest green, still matte. Everything outside the bottle must stay exactly the same, including the table and shadow.
bank.Target object: The matte black bottle in product-bottle.jpg.
bank.New appearance: Forest green with the existing matte finish and shading.
bank.Allowed edit area: Only the bottle itself. Leave the table, background and cast shadow unchanged.
bank.Size and framing: Keep the square composition without cropping or shifting; free-tier resolution is fine.

messages.text: Could you make a small color change to the bottle in this pic? I’m trying to picture how a different color would feel before I decide whether I like it. The bottle is black right now, and I want just that bottle turned forest green, keeping it matte. Everything outside the bottle must stay exactly the same, including the table and shadow. I’m a little worried that changing the color might make the whole picture feel different, which is why I’m spelling this out.
